The '''Pykes''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]].

==History==
The [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a criminal organization of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers, was led by [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and made up entirely of Pykes during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They had formed an alliance with [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], a criminal syndicate formed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].
